scope.spring: useBlobPointer now drives a critically-damped SpringProgress (response 0.18, zeta 1.0) via tick(dt) — frame-rate independent; exposes position + velocity
scope.trail: TRAIL_N=15 ring buffer, decaying radius r *= 1 - i/N, surfaced through a NEW uTrail[TRAIL_N] compile-time array (the satellite plumbing pattern, not the MAX_SATS=4 array)
scope.squash: volume-preserving anisotropic 2x2 UV warp before sdCircle (uVelocity/uStretch); perp == 1/sa exactly
scope.click: one-shot underdamped semi-implicit-Euler oscillator folded into uPulseAmp; pulse clamped > -0.9; GooBlob.vue @click + exposed pulse()
scope.pointerAttraction: sign honored (lean-in vs shy-away); config default 0.35 so hover is felt out of the box
scope.prm: substrate owns the freeze; pointer.rest() composes the deterministic rest pose on the static frame; no parallel matchMedia; first-dt clamp to 50ms

browserVerify: PENDING — the orchestrator's live Playwright audit: open the GooBlob Interaction story; a programmatic hover-then-flick across the blob must produce a measurable stretch in the motion direction within ~5 frames then a recovery toward rest; the trail reaches an elastic pseudopod toward the cursor and snaps back on leave; a click fires a visible one-shot bounce (overshoot then settle); under an emulated prefers-reduced-motion: reduce the blob paints ONE composed still frame (peak roundness, trail collapsed, zero stretch) reachable by the dock pause toggle.
